Monitor the Knowledge Kernel WAL and perform real-time QA audits.

The Truth Sentinel is the autonomous guardian of ZQK's architectural integrity.
It monitors every status transition in the WAL and performs: 
  1. Structural AST Audits (Enforcing DRY, Abstraction, Error Handling)
  2. Smoke-and-Mirrors Detection (Unimplemented TODOs, logic placeholders)
  3. Cryptographic Sign-off (Issuing QASuccess tokens)

Flags:
    --ids <stringSlice> (default: [])
      Object ids to audit when --once is set
    --once
      Audit --ids then exit (do not watch the WAL)

  Run the sentinel
  zqk.test system truth-sentinel
  Audit listed ids then exit
  zqk.test system truth-sentinel --once --ids BLI-EXAMPLE-001

Usage:
  zqk.test system truth-sentinel [flags]

Flags:
      --ids strings   Object ids to audit when --once is set
      --once          Audit --ids then exit (do not watch the WAL)

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
